title: Add full-featured form component similar to Airtable
body:
## Implement Airtable-like Feature-Complete Form Component

This PR implements a comprehensive Form component with react-hook-form integration, providing an Airtable-style form experience with validation, conditional fields, and multi-column layouts.

### Screenshots

**Form with all features:**

![Form Component](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/95b13ad8-c75d-4d66-bc3c-824668451e74)

**Conditional fields working (Team Size appears when Project Type = "Team"):**

![Conditional Fields](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5265ad01-eb38-447f-a04e-7614160a107a)

## Key Features

✅ **React Hook Form Integration** - Robust form state management and validation  
✅ **Field Validation** - Custom validation rules with error messages (minLength, maxLength, pattern, min, max, required)  
✅ **Conditional Fields** - Dynamic field visibility based on other field values using `equals`, `notEquals`, and `in` conditions  
✅ **Multi-Column Layout** - Responsive 1-4 column grid layouts  
✅ **Multiple Field Types** - Input, textarea, select, checkbox support  
✅ **Loading States** - Visual feedback during form submission  
✅ **Error Handling** - Display both validation and submission errors  
✅ **Default Values** - Pre-populate form fields  
✅ **Reset Functionality** - Clear form or reset to defaults  

## Recent Fixes

### ✅ CI Test Failure Fixed (Latest Commit)
- **Issue**: Tests were failing because `@object-ui/core` package wasn't built before running component tests
- **Solution**: Added `pretest` script to build core and react packages before running component tests
- **Files Changed**: 
  - `packages/components/package.json` - Added pretest script
  - `packages/components/vite.config.ts` - Added test configuration
- **Result**: All tests now pass ✅

### ✅ Code Review Fixes (Previous Commits)

**TypeScript Type Safety**
- Added proper interfaces: `FormFieldConfig`, `FieldValidation`, `FieldCondition`, `SelectOption`, `RenderFieldProps`
- Removed all `any` types for better type safety and IDE autocomplete
- Enhanced compile-time error detection

**Tailwind CSS Compatibility**
- Fixed dynamic class generation to use explicit classes for JIT compiler
- Changed from template literals `md:grid-cols-${columns}` to conditional logic
- Uses explicit classes: `md:grid-cols-2`, `md:grid-cols-3`, `md:grid-cols-4`
- Imported and used `cn()` utility for proper class merging

**Improved Error Handling**
- Better error type checking with `instanceof Error`
- Safe handling of various error types (Error object, string, unknown)
- Development-only console logging with proper environment checks

**Enhanced Conditional Field Logic**
- Added null/undefined safety checks for watched values
- Fixed conditions to work correctly with empty/unset values
- Improved reliability of conditional rendering

**Better Key Management**
- Fixed React key generation to use `field.id ?? name` (never index alone)
- Prevents reconciliation issues when fields are reordered

**Accessibility Improvements**
- Added `aria-label="required"` to required field asterisks
- Better screen reader support for form validation

**Select Component Enhancements**
- Added placeholder prop support for customizable select placeholders
- Added safety check for empty/undefined options array
- Proper TypeScript typing for `SelectOption` interface

**Documentation Updates**
- Clarified pattern validation accepts both string and RegExp
- Updated examples to show proper regex format

## Implementation Details

- **Component**: `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`
- **Documentation**: `docs/components/form.md`
- **Example**: Added comprehensive `airtable-form` example in playground
- **Integration**: Uses existing Shadcn UI components (Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox)
- **Merged**: Latest changes from main branch including markdown component

## Testing

All features have been comprehensively tested:

- ✅ Form renders correctly with multi-column layout
- ✅ Conditional fields show/hide based on selection (Team Size field tested)
- ✅ Validation displays error messages appropriately
- ✅ Form state management works correctly with react-hook-form
- ✅ All field types render and function properly
- ✅ Loading states display during submission
- ✅ Reset button clears form to default values
- ✅ TypeScript compilation succeeds
- ✅ Tailwind classes generate correctly (no dynamic template literals)
- ✅ Null/undefined values handled safely in conditionals
- ✅ Placeholder text works for all field types
- ✅ Required field indicators have proper accessibility
- ✅ **All tests pass in CI** (10/10 tests passing)

## Example Usage

```json
{
  "type": "form",
  "submitLabel": "Create Project",
  "columns": 2,
  "validationMode": "onBlur",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "projectName",
      "label": "Project Name",
      "type": "input",
      "required": true,
      "placeholder": "Enter project name",
      "validation": {
        "minLength": {
          "value": 3,
          "message": "Project name must be at least 3 characters"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "teamSize",
      "label": "Team Size",
      "type": "input",
      "inputType": "number",
      "placeholder": "Number of team members",
      "condition": {
        "field": "projectType",
        "in": ["team", "enterprise"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The Form component is production-ready and integrates seamlessly with the existing Object UI architecture.
